# WoWEverywhere 1.3.1

- **The app finds its updates more reliably.** The update check used GitHub's API, which allows only 60 checks an hour from one internet address. On mobile data many phones share one address, so the check could fail and the app said no update was found. It now falls back to GitHub's releases page, and Settings says when it couldn't reach GitHub instead of saying there is no update.

## Install

Download **WoWEverywhere.apk** below, or update from inside the app. It installs over 1.3.0 and keeps your settings, saved logins, game files and addons.

If Android says the app "conflicts with an existing package", your current copy came from somewhere else, such as the upstream WoW Foreverywhere releases. Uninstall it first, then install this one. Your game files and addons stay on your storage.

New to the app? See the [README](https://github.com/danielnoam/WoWEverywhere#getting-started) for setup.
